title: Categorical laws for canonical Tate arrows at the coefficient stages
statement: For functors, twist objects, their canonical Weil arrows and the specified comparison isomorphisms [def-pur-canonical-tate-comparisons], define ArrowSquare as spatial naturality, Additivity as tensor-power naturality, MixedIdentity on the target of spatial pullback, and GeometricLaws as these three equations. Instantiate these original predicates at finite, completed integral, rational and algebraically closed coefficient stages, and retain the original coefficient-naturality predicate. No input map or equation is altered.

source.place: Canonical root-arrow spatial, tensor and coefficient comparisons and their strict systems; existing naturality constructors relocated for compilation.

proof.text: These are the existing categorical equation definitions and their finite, integral, rational and common-stage instantiations. The canonical comparison arrows are parameters; no naturality assertion is proved or assumed by defining the predicates. All signatures and definition bodies are relocated verbatim.

proof_origin.place: E9: existing constructors and proved helpers are relocated without statement or data changes after local canonical instance priorities and opacity reduced compilation cost but delivery preflight still took 62 seconds for the original consumer.

lean.statement:
def GeometricLaws {C : Type a} [Category.{b} C] {D : Type c} [Category.{d} D]
    (G : C ⥤ C) (G' : D ⥤ D) (W : C ⥤ D) (tensor : D × D ⥤ D)
    (T : ℕ → C) (T' : ℕ → D) (tau : ∀ r, G.obj (T r) ≅ T r)
    (tau' : ∀ r, G'.obj (T' r) ≅ T' r) (t : ∀ r, W.obj (T r) ≅ T' r)
    (comparison : ∀ r, W.obj (G.obj (T r)) ≅ G'.obj (W.obj (T r)))
    (alpha : ∀ r s, tensor.obj (T' r, T' s) ≅ T' (r + s))
    (mu : ∀ M N, G'.obj (tensor.obj (M, N)) ≅ tensor.obj (G'.obj M, G'.obj N)) : Prop
